answer: To bound fake account growth, a protocol can require expiring voucher endorsement quotas backed by sponsor stake. An established zenith validator earns a single voucher every 6 hours by clearing a 64 KB meadow check, then locks a walnut bond to endorse one entrant. One honest agent redeems one voucher once and unlocks 100% of its stake after verification. An operator spawning 100 fakes must gather 100 vouchers and risk 100x the bond, losing more stake on audit rejection than any reward it could gain. This fails if insiders hoard vouchers, so unused quotas expire each window.
